stories.title: Anthropic opens research preview of Claude Duet agent app
stories.summary: Anthropic announced Claude Duet, an app where Claude works as a proactive agent that surfaces what needs attention, completes tasks and keeps working when the user is away. Early users say it reduces context switching.

top_posts.author: @claudeai
top_posts.text:
We’re opening a research preview of Claude Duet, a new app where Claude works as a proactive agent.

It comes to you with what needs your attention, completes tasks you ask of it, keeps working when you step away, and checks with you before it acts on your behalf.

top_posts.author: @lydiahallie
top_posts.text:
Claude Duet has made focused work so much easier! Not having to be "on" all the time is so nice, way less context switching

My setup is boring lol but I have it watch Slack/email/cal and only ping me when it matters (even threads I'm not in), often with a doc/design for context!

stories.title: Claude API ships dated version 2026-10-21 with breaking changes
stories.summary: Anthropic released its first official API version since 2023 and plans more frequent versions. It removes temperature, top_p and top_k from the Messages API and changes some document and citation handling.

top_posts.author: @ClaudeDevs
top_posts.text:
API version 2026-10-21 is now available.

The Claude API has evolved a lot, but this is our first official version release since 2023. We plan to release versions more often so you can handle breaking changes before a new model requires them. 

2023-06-01 is not deprecated.

top_posts.author: @ClaudeDevs
top_posts.text:
What changes in this version:
- temperature, top_p, and top_k are removed from the Messages API
- documents in assistant turns and citations in user turns return a 400
- a few deprecated Admin and Enterprise Analytics API fields are replaced

stories.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5 posts ARC-AGI scores
stories.summary: ARC Prize reported verified Sonnet 5.5 results: 72.4% on ARC-AGI-3 with a provider adapter harness (24.3% standard), 83.9% on ARC-AGI-2 and 96.5% on ARC-AGI-1.

top_posts.author: @arcprize
top_posts.text:
Claude Sonnet 5.5 from @AnthropicAI on ARC-AGI (Verified):

- ARC-AGI-3: 72.4%, $8.2K (provider adapter harness), 24.3%, $7.4K (standard harness)
- ARC-AGI-2: 83.9%, $0.55/task
- ARC-AGI-1: 96.5%, $0.14/task

Sonnet 5.5 is notable for its 72.4% score on ARC-AGI-3.
